text: Evaluate financial reporting systems, accounting or collection procedures, or investment activities and make recommendations for changes to procedures, operating systems, budgets, or other financial control functions.
Arrange for outside contractors to construct exhibit structures.
Test new systems to ensure that they are in working order.
Collect and deposit money into accounts, disburse funds from cash accounts to pay bills or invoices, keep records of collections and disbursements, and ensure accounts are balanced.
Instruct patients and families in work, social, and living skills, the care and use of adaptive equipment, and other skills to facilitate home and work adjustment to disability.
Establish and maintain relationships with individual or business customers or provide assistance with problems these customers may encounter.
Prepare inserts, heel pads, and lifts from casts of customers' feet.
Supervise operations or maintenance employees in the production of power from biomass, such as wood, coal, paper sludge, or other waste or refuse.
Conduct visual inspections of emission control equipment and smoke emitted from gasoline or diesel vehicles.
Evaluate technical specifications to identify equipment or systems best suited for intended use and possible purchase, based on specifications, user needs, or technical requirements.
Check conditions and weights of vessels to ensure cleanliness and compliance with loading procedures.
Plan, schedule or supervise the work of other employees.
Establish or enforce standards for protection of patients or personnel.
Prepare written documentation of electromechanical test results.
Formulate recommendations, policies, or plans to solve economic problems or to interpret markets.
Interview and hire associates to fill staff vacancies.
Assemble systems of gears by aligning and meshing gears in gearboxes.
Watch for and recognize security risks and thefts and know how to prevent or handle these situations.
Supervise and coordinate the investigation of criminal cases, offering guidance and expertise to investigators, and ensuring that procedures are conducted in accordance with laws and regulations.
Keep informed on industry news and trends, products, services, competitors, relevant information about legacy, existing, and emerging technologies, and the latest product-line developments.
Oversee installation of equipment such as water heater wraps, pipe insulation, weatherstripping, door sweeps, or low-flow showerheads to improve energy efficiency.
Develop, sell, or lease property used for industry or manufacturing.
Supervise other engineers and crew members and train them for routine and emergency duties.
Present project plans or designs to public stakeholders, such as government agencies or community groups.
Perform administrative duties, such as compiling and maintaining records, completing forms, preparing reports, or composing correspondence.
Recommend information security enhancements to management.
Write technical papers or reports or prepare standards and specifications for processes, facilities, products, or tests.
Dispose of waste material after completing work assignments.
Take product samples during or after processing for laboratory analyses.
Develop, coordinate, or monitor all aspects of production, including selection of manufacturing methods, fabrication, or operation of product designs.
Maintain archive of images, photos, or previous work products.
Perform marketing and advertising services.
Collaborate with others in the organization to ensure successful implementation of chosen problem solutions.
Maintain or repair engines, electric motors, pumps, winches, or other mechanical or electrical equipment, or assist other crew members with maintenance or repair duties.
Fabricate concrete beams, columns, and panels.
Prepare and structure data warehouses for storing data.
Test repaired items to ensure proper operation.
Create scenarios to reestablish operations from various types of business disruptions.
Administer construction contracts.
Research, compile, analyze and organize information from maps, reports, investigations, and books for use in reports and special projects.
Collect delivery instructions from appropriate sources, verifying instructions and routes.
Interview and hire applicants.
Read technical manuals, confer with users, or conduct computer diagnostics to investigate and resolve problems or to provide technical assistance and support.
Participate in required job training.
Agree on buying or selling prices at optimal levels for clients.
Maintain records of patient care, condition, progress, or problems to report and discuss observations with supervisor or case manager.
Maintain logs of recycling materials received or shipped to processing companies.
Perform testing, maintenance, repair, or upgrading of accelerator systems.
